title: February and March 2022 storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant – Terms and Conditions
summary: This document outlines the terms and conditions for the small business grant provided for recovery from the February and March 2022 storm and flood disaster.
who_can_apply: Must be an incorporated association or co-operative with Fair Trading NSW.
Must have ACNC registration or equivalent State regulatory body registration at the time of the Eligible Disaster.
Must be deemed a not-for-profit organisation in accordance with the current Australian Accounting Standards Board (AASB).
The cost must not ordinarily have been incurred in the absence of the Eligible Disaster.
The cost must exceed the costs of employing a person to clean the property, premises or equipment that would ordinarily have been incurred in the absence of the Eligible Disaster.
Property must be owned by the Small Business or Not-for-Profit Organisation, evidenced by a title search and/or Certificate of Title.
Property must be used predominantly for business activities, evidenced by financial records, photos, video evidence or a statutory declaration.
Stock replacement must be essential for immediately resuming operation.
Motor vehicles must be registered for business use and be essential for Reinstatement.
Temporary premises must be leased for the purpose of resuming operation.
what_you_need: Evidence of ownership of property (title search and/or Certificate of Title).
Financial records, photos, video evidence, or a statutory declaration to prove business use of property.
Proof of business registration (e.g., with Fair Trading NSW or ACNC).
Documentation of costs incurred (e.g., loss of income, repair quotes, replacement costs).
Agreement to disclose personal information to the ATO for auditing and compliance.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the grant?
faqs.a: Eligibility criteria include being a public company, an incorporated association or co-operative with Fair Trading NSW, or meeting specific criteria related to ACNC registration or being deemed a not-for-profit organisation.

faqs.q: What types of costs can be covered by the grant?
faqs.a: Covered costs may include loss of income caused by the disaster, repairs to a building, replacing essential stock, or repairing/replacing motor vehicles used for business.

faqs.q: What are the conditions for receiving payment?
faqs.a: Applicants must agree to disclose information to the ATO for auditing and compliance, and agree to report suspected fraud or misconduct to the ATO.
